name: Agent Hub
description: Coordination server and live Kanban dashboard for multi-agent AI coding with advisory file locking and worktree isolation. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Start with hub_whoami, hub_list_tasks, and hub_get_task to inspect server and task state without modifying records or acquiring locks.
hub_heartbeat updates agent status, last_seen_at, and sets or clears current task; hub_read_inbox marks returned messages as read for the requesting agent.
Acquire granular file locks with hub_lock_files before modifying code and promptly call hub_release_locks upon completion.
This entry matches the agent-hub-mcp executable. When launched via node or local script paths, Guard keeps its normal handling; configure it on the Protect page.
